title: Master of Clutchers
problem: The dodge still happens, so on-dodge effects fire, and then the hit goes through anyway.
notes: Text: When an enemy dodges your {RACE_Clutcher}s' attacks, they still take damage. Evidence: bc_CreatureAttack dodged branch: bc_OnDodge runs first, then the Clutchers gates @0x1406f35f9 / @0x1406f37bf let the damage through (EFFECT_ORDER attack pipeline M, L1791-L1834). Reasoning: The text itself says the enemy dodges and still takes damage, so on-dodge effects firing follows from the wording. No patch. App note (unpatched game): Against Master of Clutchers, an enemy's dodge still triggers its on-dodge effects, then the attack hits anyway. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
